name: model-alchemist
description: Compare two Power BI semantic models (PBIP / TMDL) object by object and deploy only the changes you pick.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Compare two Power BI semantic models (PBIP / TMDL) object by object and deploy only the changes you pick.
[Open Model Alchemist](command:modelAlchemist.open)
[Compare Two Models…](command:modelAlchemist.compareWith)
You can also right-click a .SemanticModel folder or a .pbip file in the Explorer and choose "Model Alchemist: Compare with…".
[Open Logs Folder](command:modelAlchemist.openLogs)

modelAlchemist.backupPath.markdownDescription: Default folder for backups taken before a deploy. Empty: the extension's own storage folder.

modelAlchemist.logPath.markdownDescription: Folder for the activity log and refresh history. Empty: the extension's own storage folder.

modelAlchemist.fabric.clientId.markdownDescription: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration that signs in to Fabric. Empty: VS Code's own sign-in app. Set it when your organisation does not let VS Code's app call the Power BI API.

modelAlchemist.fabric.tenant.markdownDescription: Directory (tenant) ID or domain to sign in to. Empty: the account's home directory (`organizations`).
